openings.claim: Bind immutable video/caption revisions through request, render and download; display the pair and pin last delivery with original wording.
openings.discriminator: Outputs match requested hashes despite edits and completion inversions; editors identify intended pairs.
openings.fit: Preserves constraints, conditional on budget feasibility.
openings.probe: Interleave cuts, captions, delayed jobs and post-submission edits in staging; compare hashes, editor selections and prior-delivery retrieval.
openings.uncertainty: Mismatch origin, label comprehension and implementation cost remain unknown.

openings.claim: Separate delay before correct-output availability from subsequent identification and watching.
openings.discriminator: Excess time before versus after availability distinguishes processing, identification or mixed causes.
openings.probe: Replay single-correction and repeated-save histories; timestamp final save, availability, selection and confirmation, separating watching and errors.
openings.uncertainty: Small staged samples need confirmation; nine successful correction sessions limit blanket rendering claims.

openings.claim: Audition changed timed cues with surrounding video in-browser; bind immutable pairs and retain embedded delivery rendering.
openings.discriminator: Fewer full renders with comparable detection of planted wording/timing errors.
openings.fit: Uncertain feasibility; retain private processing, previous delivery and full preview fallback.
openings.probe: Timebox prototype; compare audition/embedded judgments, identification time, processing and engineering effort.
openings.uncertainty: Cue context, browser timing and four-day feasibility unproven.

openings.claim: Interruptions may erase remembered intent despite accurate labels; a persistent cut/caption-excerpt receipt may restore it.
openings.discriminator: Receipt selectively reduces interruption-related selection errors or time with waits, labels and order fixed.
openings.probe: Counterbalance interruption and receipt in fabricated tasks; check selected pairs and separate waiting/selection.
openings.uncertainty: Absent interaction weakens explanation; two editors provide exploratory evidence.

decision: Stage probes on existing private accounts within four engineer-days, one editor-day and 80 hours/week collectively. Synthetic evidence proves no outcome: confirm >=27/30 within 15 minutes and zero unintended delivered pairs. Festival capacity remains unknown.
